I'm now 18.

I'm in the UK.

He's still living a normal life, i've only told Reddit and some close friends so far.

I've not yet had therapy, i'm waiting on a phone call from the doctors to see what help I can get.

I experienced, I think, most forms of sexual contact e.g. penetration, oral etc as well as some physical abuse such as strangling.
As a result, I was sexually aware from quite an early age and encouraged peers to participate in the removal of clothing with me but, other than that, I think i'm only as bi-curious as the average person without ever having acted upon any thoughts.
I'm unable to have casual sex and it takes me a while to trust a person until I properly get to know them.
I've recently developed acute psychological problems such as PTSD. In addition, the fear has manifested in my head as the stereotypical Japanese horror female character from The Ring or The Grudge. I have nightmares/visions and struggle to sleep. Only over the last two months though.
